manifest.boundary_convention: inclusive outer bounds; duplicate timestamps removed
manifest.grouping_note: Empirical labels, not independently validated certainty; G1/G2 only

split.algorithm: sorted groups; numpy PCG64 shuffle; largest remainder on group counts v1

model.name: HR-Power · struttura selezionabile
model.equation: tau dx/dt + x = K (P(t-L)-P0); HRhat = B+x
model.source: P1D richiesto nel protocollo utente; nessuna replica bibliografica rivendicata
model.initial_conditions: P0=mean(Ppre); HR0=HR(0); x(0)=HR0-B; B estimated; P(t<0)=P0
model.input_reconstruction: zero-order hold, integrazione esatta; ritardo continuo in secondi
model.uncertainty: SSE/(N-p) inv(J.T J); p=parametri liberi; CI95 Wald non troncati; condizionati a P0 e HR0
model.delay_domain: 0 <= L <= min(Lmax,T); T=t[-1]-t[0]; Lmax=null significa T; Lmax=0 fissa L=0
model.identification_validity: Convergenza e compatibilità numerica/temporale; non certifica precisione o identificabilità
model.residual_conventions: e=HR-HRhat; SD ddof=1; centered ACF denominator=sum(e_centered**2); lag in samples
model.multistart_conventions: PCG64; first start nominal; log-uniform K/tau or gamma, uniform L/B; optional deterministic profile grid; select minimum SSE across all refinements
model.rho_convention: (T-L)/tau for P1D full; null for short_transient; no exclusion thresholds
model.profile_conventions: Uniform L, log tau; bounded analytic K (and B when estimated); diverse grid candidates refined with full-parameter TRF; no global optimum guarantee
